evidence: entity-graph.py writes KG triples (weight >= 2) to knowledge_graph.sqlite3 and produces entity-registry.json. KG timestamp format required: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (not Python's +00:00 format). staleness-checker.py calls kg.invalidate() on EXPIRED/SUPERSEDED drawer transitions. EntityGraph produces canonical entity names — Polish and Specify reference these for naming consistency checks. team-plan module reads entity registry for multi-person task coordination. add_triple() requires valid_from in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ format. KG triples threshold: weight >= 2 (raw co-occurrence must appear at least twice to be promoted to KG).
